name: MedPulse EHR
domain: Hospital Inpatient Clinical Health Records and Ward Management
description: Hospital clinical information system for inpatient wards, triage, and nurse stations. Provides patient chart reviews, active medication orders, vital sign telemetry, lab result alert badges, clinical doctor handover notes, and allergy warnings under strict patient safety standards.

operatingEnvironment: Point-of-care mobile workstation cart and ward desk displays
